null_hypothesis: The transparent rule-based regime baseline does not predict the forward efficiency/ATR-barrier target OOS beyond a trivial benchmark.
test_statistic: OOS predictive power (AUC for barrier-hit target, or IC for continuous efficiency target)
target: A: price hits +2*ATR before -1*ATR within next H bars

method.split: one train / one validation / one locked final test (~20%)
method.cost: single round-trip, applied on turnover only

deflation: count all prior trials (>= 20) as search width
positive_control: injected known efficiency/barrier edge must be recovered
negative_control: shape present but effect absent -> silent
failure_action: document null, scope precisely, do not soften gate
